genes.name: symmetric
genes.hypothesis: Searching over mirror orbits (x -> n-1-x, y -> n-1-y: four points at a time) quarters the search space and, because the counters fold onto one quadrant, also quarters the cost of a move. The published sets have this symmetry: all 164 points at n = 100 and 108 of 112 at n = 64. The last part of the budget drops the constraint and continues point by point.
genes.predicted: +4 to +10 points at n >= 64 at equal CPU time
genes.author: seed

genes.name: greedy_victim
genes.hypothesis: Taking out the unit that sits in the most forbidden triples (exact gain, random ties) repairs the set faster than taking out a random conflicted unit, as in best-move tabu search.
genes.predicted: +3 to +8 points at n >= 64 at equal CPU time
genes.author: seed

genes.name: hollow
genes.hypothesis: The published sets keep almost every point within a few rows of the border (depth at most 11 of 32 at n = 64, at most 26 of 50 at n = 100). Excluding the middle of the grid removes candidates that sit on many bisectors and shortens every scan.
genes.predicted: +0 to +2 points at equal CPU time
genes.author: seed

genes.name: tabu_tenure
genes.hypothesis: A unit taken out stays out for tabu_tenure to 2 * tabu_tenure steps; long enough to stop cycling, short enough to keep good units available.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: patience
genes.hypothesis: Iterations without a new best before a kick; too small never finishes a level, too large wastes time in a dead basin.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: kick_fraction
genes.hypothesis: A kick returns to the best set and removes this fraction of its units at random; 1.0 is a full restart.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: sym_fraction
genes.hypothesis: Share of the budget spent in the symmetric phase before the point-by-point phase; the best published set at n = 64 is a symmetric set changed in four points.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: axis_shift_x
genes.hypothesis: Moves the vertical mirror axis half a cell off the grid centre (x -> n-1+shift-x); the source paper says the two axes need not meet in the midpoint.
genes.author: seed

genes.name: axis_shift_y
genes.hypothesis: Moves the horizontal mirror axis half a cell off the grid centre (y -> n-1+shift-y).
genes.author: seed

genes.name: band_frac
genes.hypothesis: With hollow on, only points within band_frac * n of the border are used; 0.5 is the whole grid.
